tools.name: d7_get_balance
tools.description: Read the D7 account's remaining credit balance (free; no credit is spent). D7 REST: GET /messages/v1/balance.

tools.name: d7_get_sms_pricing
tools.description: Read the account's price per SMS part, for one country or for all countries (free; no credit is spent). Use it to estimate the cost before d7_send_sms. D7 REST: GET /messages/v1/sms/pricing.

tools.name: d7_get_message_status
tools.description: Read the delivery status of an SMS request: per recipient the status (delivered, sent, scheduled, un_delivered, not_reachable, spam_content, insufficient_credit), message parts and cost (free). D7 REST: GET /report/v1/message-log/{request_id}.

tools.name: d7_get_lookup_report
tools.description: Read the stored result of an earlier number lookup by its request_id (free; no credit is spent). D7 REST: GET /hlr/v1/report/{request_id}.

tools.name: d7_lookup_number
tools.description: WRITE (spends credits): look up ONE phone number's carrier data (country, network, MCC/MNC, ported, reachable, mobile or fixed). Each lookup is billed to the D7 account's credit balance (the cost is returned by d7_get_lookup_report as number_lookup_cost) and the account must have lookup routing enab

tools.name: d7_send_sms
tools.description: WRITE (sends real text messages and spends credits): send ONE text message to 1-10 recipients (never a list or campaign). Each recipient costs the per-country price for every message part (about 160 GSM characters or 70 unicode characters per part; see d7_get_sms_pricing), taken from the D7 credit b

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: d7_get_balance, d7_get_sms_pricing, d7_get_message_status, d7_send_sms · Public sink: d7_get_sms_pricing, d7_get_message_status, d7_lookup_number, d7_send_sms.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: d7_get_balance, d7_get_sms_pricing, d7_get_message_status, d7_send_sms · Public sink: d7_get_sms_pricing, d7_get_message_status, d7_lookup_number, d7_send_sms

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
